in_marathi.name: Atiksh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Wisdom Before Action
in_marathi.long_meaning: Atiksh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Atiksh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ati' meaning 'beyond' and 'ksh' meaning 'knowledge'. This name signifies having wisdom before taking action. It is a name for a boy who is wise and thoughtful.
